Agent Name: Verification_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The first clear error occurs when the Verification_Expert claims the hikes were “verified” and then selects final hikes without actually confirming the two required conditions: (a) that each hike was recommended by at least three different people with kids, and (b) that TripAdvisor ratings were truly at least 4.5/5 from at least 50 reviews. In particular, the agent relied on vague search snippets and inferred ratings (“high,” “above 4.5”) instead of extracting exact TripAdvisor averages, and it also never substantiated the “at least three different people with kids” requirement. This makes the solution unsupported and potentially incorrect.
